author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

Eggs and chicken are some of the most familiar and comforting flavors on a Yunnan countryside table.

From picking up warm eggs from the coop in the early morning, to simmering a fragrant pot of free-range chicken in the courtyard; from simple homemade egg dishes to a lively table full of chicken delicacies, every dish carries the taste of childhood and the warmth of family gathered around the table.

In this episode, we’ve put together a collection of past videos featuring chicken and egg dishes. Let’s see how many delicious hometown flavors Yunnan people can create from just one chicken and one egg.

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge, a Yunnan native. If you enjoy my videos, please keep subscribing to my channel. I'll continue to share my life and Yunnan-styled food in my uploads. Wish you have a happy life and enjoy tasty food every day
